# LVGL dependency

Official LVGL 9.4.0, commit `c016f72d4c125098287be5e83c0f1abed4706ee5`.
Source: https://github.com/lvgl/lvgl/tree/c016f72d4c125098287be5e83c0f1abed4706ee5

Copied from an existing clean local checkout because shell network access was
unavailable. Includes the unmodified `src/`, desktop CMake support, root build
headers/templates, and MIT license (`lvgl/LICENCE.txt`). Upstream demos, tests,
documentation, and Git metadata are omitted. No download is needed to build.
Keep this dependency separate from application changes; do not edit it to build UI.
